items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1959-03-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...I think you mentioned George Boyd, did you once? Yeah, George Boyd. [INTERVIEWEE] What did he play like?

ctx.x: It seems to me most of them played about the same style.
Some of the other players around I guess you got to hear, I think you mentioned George Boyd, did you once? Yeah, George Boyd.
